message.content:
The vulnerability is at line 10: `tag_len` is caller-controlled and never validated against `sizeof(full_tag)` (16 bytes). A caller requesting a tag longer than 16 bytes causes `memcpy` to read past the end of the stack buffer `full_tag`, leaking adjacent stack memory into the caller's tag buffer (an out-of-bounds read / information disclosure). The check on line 7 only guards against a NULL pointer, not an oversized length.

Answer: 10
